goal: Design the requested change against the pinned source. Supply Findings and Recommendation, interfaces, invariants, rejected alternatives, repository citations and testable acceptance. No implementation before independent acceptance.

original_issue.goal: Refuse composition of an issue workflow when diagnosis or design concerns another issue on the same source.

acceptance: Composition refuses a report stage whose original issue goal differs from the implementation.
Composition refuses missing issue details or different original acceptance, even with identical source and Pipeline.
Valid diagnosis and design keep distinct report acceptance and preserve exact final whole-change verification.
Explain how the exact original_issue can be substituted by a same-source report for another issue; cite scripts/issue-workflows.py.
Design a bounded Requirements contract, author/verifier dataflow, composition and native reconciliation checks, and positive/negative tests.
Judge report completeness against original_issue without claiming its implementation acceptance is satisfied.
